label: HARD_NEGATIVE
purpose: Construct challenging non-LPZ comparators without contaminating the label with trivial fair-weather periods or future information.

candidate_classes.description: Strong analyzed rainfall in a primary subdivision/time window with no overlapping JMA realized-positive anchor.
High-resolution radar morphology is elongated/organized but translates rather than satisfying a future frozen persistence/stationarity comparator definition.
Organized high-resolution precipitation object that dissipates before a future frozen persistence criterion.
Embedded 50/80 mm/h cores occur but parent lineage fails a future frozen temporal comparator definition.
Retrospective environmental diagnostics are favorable but no official realized-positive anchor occurs in the protected spatiotemporal window.
Heavy-rain accumulation approaches a future frozen objective threshold without becoming an official realized-positive case.

protected_positive_window.policy: A candidate sharing a protected primary subdivision and falling inside the protected time window of a realized-positive anchor is excluded from HARD_NEGATIVE labeling. Cross-subdivision adjacency is retained as a future spatial-buffer audit rather than guessed here.

class_balance_policy.rule: Do not force 1:1 class balance before observing available case counts. Preserve the natural candidate pool and use analysis weights/resampling only inside development experiments if later justified.

split_policy.principle: Temporal split before feature selection. All rows belonging to the same eventual episode/group must stay in one split.
